description: 【有料 / 30 JPY】旅行者の購入額・荷物寸法・旅行日を指定し、日本の法規制適合性（新免税対象可否・特大荷物事前予約義務・祝日混雑リスク）を即決自動判定します。AIお小遣い月額上限ロック連動（1回30円、sk_souon_...必須）。 / Instant automated compliance evaluation for Japan inbound travel regulations: tax-free shopping eligibility (Nov 2026 reform), Shinkansen oversized baggage rules, or peak holiday congestion risk. 30 JPY per check, requires AI allowance API key.

apiKey.description: AIお小遣いキー / AI allowance API key (sk_souon_...). Authorization Bearer header also supported.

baggageTotalCm.description: 荷物3辺合計（cm。checkType === 'shinkansen_baggage' で使用） / Total baggage dimensions in cm (length + width + height) (for shinkansen_baggage check)

checkType.description: 判定種別 ('tax_free', 'shinkansen_baggage', 'holiday_peak') / Compliance check type: 'tax_free', 'shinkansen_baggage', or 'holiday_peak'

purchaseAmountJpy.description: 購入金額（税抜日本円。checkType === 'tax_free' で使用） / Purchase amount in JPY excluding tax (for tax_free check)

travelDate.description: 旅行日 (YYYY-MM-DD。checkType === 'holiday_peak' で使用) / Travel date in YYYY-MM-DD format (for holiday_peak check)

name: check_jp_travel_compliance
